items.title: # Summarize Long Emails
items.content: Paste lengthy emails into your AI to get key takeaways instantly. This saves you time by quickly grasping the main points without reading everything.

items.title: # Draft Quick Replies
items.content: Tell your AI the context and what you want to say. It will generate a professional draft, speeding up your response time significantly.

items.title: # Refine Email Tone
items.content: Ask your AI to rewrite a draft to be more formal, friendly, or concise. It helps ensure your message is always clear and appropriate.

items.title: # Brainstorm Email Ideas
items.content: Stuck on what to write? Give your AI a topic and audience, and it will suggest various content angles or subject lines to get you started.

items.title: # Summarize Long Emails
items.content: Paste lengthy emails or articles into an AI tool. Ask it to provide the main points in a few sentences, saving you time from reading everything.

items.title: # Generate Content Ideas
items.content: Stuck for ideas? Prompt AI with your topic and audience. It can quickly suggest engaging blog posts, social media captions, or video scripts.

items.title: # Rephrase Your Text
items.content: Need to make your writing clearer or change its tone? Paste your draft and ask AI to rephrase it. It helps refine your message effortlessly.

items.title: # Polish Your Writing
items.content: Before sending, let AI proofread your documents. It catches grammar errors, spelling mistakes, and suggests improvements for better clarity.

items.title: # Summarize Long Articles
items.content: Paste long articles or reports into an AI tool to get a quick summary. This saves time by giving you the main points without reading everything.

items.title: # Generate Research Questions
items.content: Stuck on where to start? Ask AI to brainstorm potential research questions or angles on a topic. It provides a great starting point for your investigation.

items.title: # Extract Key Data
items.content: Upload unstructured text or tables to AI and ask it to pull out specific data points. This quickly organizes information, making it easier to analyze.

items.title: # Simplify Complex Topics
items.content: Feed AI a dense academic paper or technical concept and ask for a simple explanation. It helps you grasp difficult ideas faster and clarify understanding.

items.title: # Summarize Long Emails
items.content: Paste long emails into an AI tool to get the key points instantly. This saves you time reading unnecessary details and helps you respond faster.

items.title: # Brainstorm Content Ideas
items.content: Stuck on a project? Ask AI for ideas on topics, outlines, or creative angles. It provides a quick starting point to overcome writer's block.

items.title: # Format Your Data
items.content: Give AI unorganized text or data and ask it to format it cleanly. Use it for lists, tables, or extracting specific information from messy notes.

items.title: # Draft Quick Messages
items.content: Need to reply quickly? Have AI draft short messages, social posts, or quick reports. Review and edit to fit your tone, saving you precious typing time.

items.title: # Refine Initial Drafts
items.content: After getting a first draft, ask AI to "make it more concise" or "expand on point X." This helps you quickly tailor the output to your exact needs without starting over.

items.title: # Clarify Complex Ideas
items.content: If an AI explanation is unclear, ask "Can you explain that like I'm five?" or "Give me an example." This simplifies complex topics for better understanding.

items.title: # Explore More Options
items.content: If you need more ideas, ask "Give me 5 more suggestions" or "What are some alternatives?" This pushes the AI to generate a wider range of possibilities for your task.

items.title: # Format Data Better
items.content: After getting raw information, ask AI to "put this into a table" or "summarize these points." This quickly organizes data into a usable format.

items.title: # Summarize Emails Quickly
items.content: Ask AI to summarize long emails into bullet points. This helps you grasp key information fast without reading every detail.

items.title: # Format Data Tables
items.content: Input raw data and tell AI to organize it into a table. This saves time on manual formatting for reports or presentations.

items.title: # Brainstorm Idea Lists
items.content: Generate ideas for content or projects by asking AI for a numbered list. It provides structured inspiration instantly.

items.title: # Create Meeting Agendas
items.content: Prompt AI to create a clear meeting agenda with specific sections. This ensures all key topics are covered efficiently.

items.title: # Project Breakdown Plan
items.content: Give AI a big project and ask it to list the key stages and actions needed. This helps you see the whole picture and tackle it one step at a time.

items.title: # Solve Issues Stepwise
items.content: When facing a problem, ask AI to outline potential causes and a step-by-step troubleshooting guide. This provides a clear path to finding a solution efficiently.

items.title: # Outline Your Content
items.content: Before writing, ask AI to create a detailed outline for your topic. Then, expand on each point, ensuring logical flow and comprehensive coverage.

items.title: # Learn Anything Easily
items.content: To grasp a new topic, prompt AI to explain it in simple, sequential steps. This breaks down complex information into digestible, easy-to-understand parts.
